audience: analysts and teams that report with dashboards in Klipfolio

useCases.title: Audit your dashboards
useCases.text: List the dashboards and the Klips on them. Open one to read its settings.

useCases.title: Review users and groups
useCases.text: List the users and the groups of an account to check who has access.
